title: Almost sure hypothesis testing in physiotherapy: code and derived data
description:
Code and derived data reproducing every number, table and figure of “Moving the goalposts on purpose: almost sure hypothesis testing and what it would do to physiotherapy trials”.

Almost sure hypothesis testing lets the significance level shrink with the sample size, αn = n−p with p > 1, so that with probability one only finitely many errors of either kind occur (Naaman, Electron J Stat 2016;10:1526–50). This archive applies that rule to three open-access physiotherapy trials spanning n = 140 to 2249, to the primary outcome of 21 trials with openly deposited individual participant data, and to 256 musculoskeletal trials reanalysed from published summary statistics.

Rscript run_all.R reproduces all of it in about 15 seconds and needs only base R plus readxl. Third-party data are not redistributed: the Bleakley et al. supplement is CC BY-NC-ND and is downloaded on first run, and the 21 deposits are named by resolvable link in data/ipd_reference_specs.csv, since ten of them carry no licence permitting redistribution.
